cases.scenario: Governed Payment Lifecycle dataset
cases.conditionalInference: A promise of trusted state/event representation principally supports a **Data Product** investigation; timestamps/context alone do not make it Information
cases.requiredEvidence: BPS Productness and actual external Data Product qualification

cases.scenario: Dataset with settlement-duration and corridor measures
cases.conditionalInference: Derived metrics could be constituents of a Data Product, or support a different productized informational proposition
cases.requiredEvidence: Primary Product Promise, semantic intent and constituting relationship to each measure

cases.scenario: One-off internal KPI dashboard
cases.conditionalInference: A chart can be meaningful Information without evidence that the chart/occurrence is itself a Product
cases.requiredEvidence: Product identity, owner, promise, lifecycle and independent BPS Productness

cases.scenario: Reusable corridor-performance subscription
cases.conditionalInference: Bounded settlement-performance proposition is a plausible Info VBE, if intentional Productness and governed semantics are established
cases.requiredEvidence: Promise, semantic methods, source eligibility, consumer contract, Product version

cases.scenario: Versioned analytical PDF brief
cases.conditionalInference: Fixed delivery format and lack of a running analytical engine do not disqualify a potentially qualified informational offering
cases.requiredEvidence: Distinguish published Product edition from one-off PDF artifact; Productness/semantic governance

cases.scenario: Human-curated market interpretation
cases.conditionalInference: Human curation can constitute meaningful Information without engine ownership
cases.requiredEvidence: Interpretive frame, method, evidence, bounded promise and Productness

cases.scenario: BI tool offering arbitrary calculations
cases.conditionalInference: A generic calculation/visualization capability does not automatically have an informational VBE
cases.requiredEvidence: Actual promise; is the subject a tool/service or a specifically constituted informational product?

cases.scenario: AI Product summarizes settlement metrics
cases.conditionalInference: AI dependency does not classify the containing output; one-off summary need not be a Product
cases.requiredEvidence: Subject identity and whether anything new is intentionally productized

cases.scenario: Governed AI inference service
cases.conditionalInference: If intrinsic promise is a qualified intelligence capability, AIPS is a stronger family authority
cases.requiredEvidence: Independent AIPS qualification and precise Product Promise

cases.scenario: Threshold-driven late-settlement alert
cases.conditionalInference: Information occurrence, recommendation, decision and action must be separated
cases.requiredEvidence: Owner/actor/authority, alert Productness, semantic contract and downstream authorization

cases.scenario: Information offering consuming another Information Product
cases.conditionalInference: A distinct bounded informational promise is possible without inheriting upstream identity
cases.requiredEvidence: New Product Promise, constitution, differentiated informational value and identity

cases.scenario: Metric + explanation + simulation
cases.conditionalInference: Could be one coherent Info proposition family, a platform/service or a real compound Product
cases.requiredEvidence: Boundedness/coherence, primary VBE, distinct component promises

cases.scenario: Refreshing fraud-monitoring report with AI inputs
cases.conditionalInference: Neither refresh pattern nor AI dependency alone determines family; a bounded interpreted report is plausible
cases.requiredEvidence: Promise, semantic context, AIPS dependency currentness, Productness

cases.scenario: Ad hoc direct analytical consumption
cases.conditionalInference: GEARM/GEARA allow direct consumption without Productization
cases.requiredEvidence: Separate intentional qualified Product identity, if asserted

cases.scenario: Same metrics/ports with different semantics
cases.conditionalInference: Identical payload does not establish same informational meaning or Product version
cases.requiredEvidence: Population, period, method, relevant definition/authority versions

cases.scenario: Historical report after metric change
cases.conditionalInference: Historical meaning belongs to the definition/occurrence-time evidence, not the newest metric definition
cases.requiredEvidence: Referenced historical semantic version and effective period

cases.scenario: Marketplace chart with high maturity
cases.conditionalInference: Listing and maturity cannot create either Productness or Information family membership
cases.requiredEvidence: Independent BPS Product evidence and PIN analysis; PMDD assessed later

cases.scenario: Commercial bundle: feed + analysis + AI recommendations
cases.conditionalInference: A commercial bundle need not give each component a common intrinsic Product Family
cases.requiredEvidence: Which subject is qualified: bundle, constituent Product, or composite with a new promise?

cases.scenario: Published annual research analysis
cases.conditionalInference: A stable, intentionally Productized governed interpretation can be an Info candidate even after authoring machinery has gone
cases.requiredEvidence: BPS Productness; method/frame/context; versioned editorial controls

cases.scenario: Generic mathematical / analytics API
cases.conditionalInference: Offering compute without a bounded informational promise suggests a generic capability/service, not Information merely because it returns numbers
cases.requiredEvidence: Actual VBE/EVC and specified service terms

cases.scenario: Data Product with VWAP and semantic metadata
cases.conditionalInference: Even extensive analytical calculations are not sufficient to replace a Data-representation Product Promise
cases.requiredEvidence: Governing primary promise and external Data Product requirements

cases.scenario: Same Crypto Market Info intent, three enterprises
cases.conditionalInference: PFI engine/topology/API/AI differences alone cannot reclassify a Product; semantics/currentness must be verified separately
cases.requiredEvidence: Contract-normalized semantic equivalence, identity/versions and realization evidence

cases.scenario: AI-powered/AI-created Comic, Movie, Car or Rocket
cases.conditionalInference: Use, containment or AI-origin does not automatically change primary intrinsic VBE/EVC
cases.requiredEvidence: PIN of each actual containing Product, not just AI dependency labels

cases.scenario: Market information promise changes into trading intelligence
cases.conditionalInference: Real change of primary promised value requires requalification; cannot hide it as a new AI golden path
cases.requiredEvidence: Versioned new promise, AIPS qualification, possible compound/Product identity decision

cases.scenario: Repository, build archive and multiple deployments
cases.conditionalInference: Implementation representations do not automatically constitute separate Product identities or the full Product
cases.requiredEvidence: Logical Product identity, artifacts, builds, deployments and occurrence links

cases.scenario: External mathematics API in Info Product runtime
cases.conditionalInference: Generated caller belongs to executable realization; external API remains separately owned; invocation remains a governed boundary
cases.requiredEvidence: Blueprint Binding, API capability/contract version, semantics and trace evidence

cases.scenario: Same numeric values, different populations or periods
cases.conditionalInference: Payload equality cannot override differences in governing informational meaning
cases.requiredEvidence: Semantic definition identities, effective periods and population/time rules

cases.scenario: Different asset/time parameters for one Product
cases.conditionalInference: Valid runtime parameter variation need not create a new Product version or family
cases.requiredEvidence: Parameter contract, allowed context range, identity invariants

cases.scenario: Governance-free AI-generated market narrative
cases.conditionalInference: A convincing narrative is produced but no Product subject, applicable information frame, source rules or logic/meaning authority is evidenced. Informational content by itself cannot certify Information Productness
cases.requiredEvidence: Context alone versus Productness, H01/H03/H05

cases.scenario: Static governed information edition; engine retired
cases.conditionalInference: A specific versioned published market-analysis Product continues to offer its promised report after the historical authoring tools are gone
cases.requiredEvidence: Refutes universal own-engine/active-execution requirement, H03/H10

cases.scenario: A subscription bundling information and autonomous trade execution
cases.conditionalInference: If it independently promises interpreted market information **and** governed consequential trading capability, treating it as an uncomplicated single-family Information Product is unjustified
cases.requiredEvidence: Compound/changed essential value, H01/H04/H05

cases.scenario: Same bounded analytical publication delivered by PDF or API
cases.conditionalInference: If the same versioned promise/meaning is preserved, replacing the interface does not change intrinsic family
cases.requiredEvidence: Delivery-medium sufficiency, H02/H10

cases.scenario: AI-generated explanation supplements governed VWAP
cases.conditionalInference: If metric and information promise are unchanged, an independently qualified AI dependency does not automatically transform the containing Product into an AI Product
cases.requiredEvidence: Non-transitivity, H04/H07

cases.scenario: PFI replaces specified VWAP with a different estimator
cases.conditionalInference: Even if the outputs are numerically close in one test, changing the governing analytical calculation is not proven equivalent and may breach the Product Promise
cases.requiredEvidence: PFI semantic authority, H03/H05/H07/H09

cases.scenario: Same spec independently owned by three enterprises
cases.conditionalInference: Independent Product identities can implement the same semantic Product Kind and intent. Same Family/Kind is not instance identity
cases.requiredEvidence: Cross-enterprise identity, H06/H10

cases.scenario: A shared runtime serves ten informational Products
cases.conditionalInference: One execution engine and shared deployment do not collapse ten separately promised and owned informational Products into a single Product
cases.requiredEvidence: Hosting/realization conflation, H09/H10
